"import cadquery as cq

# Local sketch coordinates (mm) on the YZ plane.
# (u, v) -> global (0, u, v)  [local u -> global +Y, v -> global +Z]
vertices = [
    (-38.615146, -15.721934),
    (-14.65608,  -33.776385),
    ( 12.959065, -22.054451),
    ( 16.615146,   7.721934),
    ( -7.34392,  25.776385),
    (-34.959065,  14.054451),
]

P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

edges = []
n = len(vertices)
for i in range(n):
    u1, v1 = vertices[i]
    u2, v2 = vertices[(i + 1) % n]   # wrap-around closes the loop
    p1 = P.toWorldCoords((u1, v1))
    p2 = P.toWorldCoords((u2, v2))
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2))

cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
